question: Will London hit 21°C on Tuesday, Oct 13, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the recorded daily maximum air temperature at 2 metres above ground for London, UK on 2026-10-13 (strictly after 2026-10-12T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-13T23:00:00Z) is at or above 21°C according to credible meteorological sources.
- "No": Wins if the recorded daily maximum air temperature at 2 metres above ground for London, UK on 2026-10-13 (strictly after 2026-10-12T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-13T23:00:00Z) remains strictly below 21°C according to credible meteorological sources.

Clarifications:
- "Hit 21°C" means the daily maximum temperature (Tmax) at 2 metres above ground reaches or exceeds 21.0°C at any point during the UTC window strictly after 2026-10-12T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-13T23:00:00Z, as recorded by official or widely recognised meteorological observation networks covering Greater London (e.g. Heathrow/LHR, London Weather Centre, or equivalent official station).
